name: 97210 · Portland, OR
findings: ZIP 97210 (Portland) has 106 nonprofit organizations. 59 of them (56%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 49 organizations.
Health care organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (15% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 97210 (Portland) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
32% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 97210 (Portland) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.0 times the typical level).
